intent: H.264 twin of c15-start-kfloss: the first key frame loses an FU-A fragment of its IDR. The track buffer asks early, 200-240 ms after the reveal. The trace does not answer, so it asks again a second later. The expiry's report is coalesced into them, and frames from the frame-60 key frame on are written. Unlike the VP8 seed, the writer does not ask: the track buffer's request is still due. RED when the early gap request is removed (one request, at the 2 s expiry), or when the writer asks without consulting keyframeDue (1 writer request).
